channel.title: MĀKI News & Articles
channel.description: Projects, case studies and news from MĀKI Autonomous Systems, New Zealand.

item.title: Underwater 3D Mapping and Jetty Survey at Hobsonville Point
item.description: How do you survey underneath a jetty where conventional boats struggle to access? MĀKI combined multibeam USV bathymetry with RTK drone photogrammetry at Hobsonville Point, Auckland.

item.title: Building Smart Monitoring for Remote Environments: MAKI's IoT AI Camera Solution
item.description: A custom IoT AI camera solution for remote monitoring where power, connectivity, access and environmental conditions make standard systems unsuitable.

item.title: Final Testing Completed: Integrated Marine IoT Monitoring System
item.description: Final testing is complete for an in-house marine IoT platform integrating water-quality sensors, underwater camera footage and onboard lighting.

item.title: MAKI at Freshwater Conference 2025 - Connections, Innovation, and New Possibilities
item.description: MĀKI exhibited at Freshwater Conference 2025, sharing autonomous boat, ROV, mapping and monitoring capabilities with councils, researchers and environmental scientists.

item.title: Topo-Bathymetric Mapping at Aotea Harbour
item.description: MĀKI completed a topo-bathymetry survey at Aotea Harbour for Ōtorohanga District Council using RTK bathymetry and drone photogrammetry.

item.title: Autonomous Water Monitoring and Sampling During Algae Bloom Events
item.description: MĀKI collaborated with Waikato Regional Council to deploy MĀKI Boat V2 for autonomous water-quality monitoring and sampling during algae bloom events.

item.title: MĀKI Makes the News at Fieldays 2025
item.description: MĀKI was featured in a national Newsroom story following Fieldays 2025 — spotlighted among innovative enterprises contributing to New Zealand's rural sector development.

item.title: Advancements in Bathymetry Mapping for Efficient Settling Pond Management
item.description: In recent years, bathymetry mapping has emerged as an essential tool for settling pond management — allowing owners and operators to evaluate operations effectively, saving both time and resources.

item.title: MĀKI's Breakthrough in Autonomous Water Quality Monitoring
item.description: In March 2024, MĀKI partnered with the Waikato Regional Council on a pioneering autonomous water quality data collection initiative during a hazardous algae bloom event.

item.title: Lakes Mapping for Waikato Regional Council
item.description: MĀKI is now contracted to conduct lakes bathymetric mapping for the Waikato Regional Council, using in-house autonomous boats to efficiently and accurately gather data from the region's lakes.

item.title: Ngaroto Lake Scanning
item.description: The MĀKI team conducted field trials at Lake Ngaroto using a new CHIRP MEGA SI GPS scanner mounted on an inflatable e-kayak — producing comprehensive bathymetric mapping, 3D models and side-scan imagery.
